SSH:
  host: <LOOPBACK>
  alias: erun-team-dev
  port: 17022
  user: erun
  key: none
  workspace: <HOME>/git/team
audit: erun open --dry-run --vscode team dev
config: would assign localportrangestart=17000 to team/dev
trace-log: would append the full trace to <TMP>
open: tenant=team environment=dev kubernetes-context=test-context remote=true no-shell=false ide=vscode
open: pure primitive — not deploying (run `erun deploy` first, or pass --deploy to deploy before opening)
kubectl --context test-context --namespace team-dev get deployment team-devops -o name
sshd: dry-run: no SSH public key found; use --public-key to choose one; using placeholder key for trace
kubectl --context test-context --namespace team-dev exec deployment/team-devops -- /bin/sh -lc '<remote-script>'
remote-ssh-authorized-keys:
  set -eu
  mkdir -p "$HOME/.ssh"
  chmod 700 "$HOME/.ssh"
  key_file="$HOME/.ssh/authorized_keys"
  tmp_keys="$(mktemp)"
  tmp_new="$(mktemp)"
  touch "$key_file"
  chmod 600 "$key_file"
  cat > "$tmp_new" <<'EOF'
  <placeholder-public-key>
  EOF
  grep -Fvx -f "$tmp_new" "$key_file" > "$tmp_keys" || true
  cat "$tmp_new" >> "$tmp_keys"
  mv "$tmp_keys" "$key_file"
  rm -f "$tmp_new"
  chmod 600 "$key_file"
kubectl --context test-context --namespace team-dev port-forward deployment/team-devops 17022:17022 --address <LOOPBACK>
kubectl --context test-context --namespace team-dev port-forward deployment/team-devops 17000:17000 --address <LOOPBACK>
kubectl --context test-context --namespace team-dev get deployment erun-api -o name
kubectl --context test-context --namespace team-dev port-forward service/erun-api 17033:17033 --address <LOOPBACK>
ssh-keyscan -p 17022 <LOOPBACK>
open vscode://vscode-remote/ssh-remote+erun-team-dev<HOME>/git/team
